notes.title: Full Release Patch #8: Steam Deck support and more!
notes.content:
[b]Full Release version 2022-03-06 changelog:[/b]

- Bigger font for more readability on small screens such as the Deck.
- New personal skill for Kuroko: Hack, efficient on machines.
- You can now disable weapon elemental damage by pressing L1/R1 / ARROWS (left/right hand) when on the weapon's command.
- The various leaderboards are now visible on the title screen > extras menu.
- Aura effect on the top of the screen when walking in a known battlezone, fading from green to red indicating the next encounter.
- New graphics option: Target framerate, from 30 to 120 FPS.
- New option for choosing between Xbox and PlayStation gamepad glyphs.
- New option: Pixel transition, that looks great when using the CRT filter.
- Added MacOSX M1 (Arm) native binaries.

And many more improvements and fixes!

If you've missed the announcement, Episode 2 is now fully released on Steam!

Thanks for your support 😊

notes.title: Full Release Patch #7: 2nd Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[b]Full Release version 2021-07-09 changelog:[/b]

- The game now default to [b]Easy Mode[/b] - for players that want to focus on the exploration and story. You can switch back anytime to [b]Hard Mode[/b] in the options on the title menu - for more challenging battles.
- During battles the turns view now display the [b]timing of your next move[/b].
- Haru now have a new personal skill: [b]Protect[/b]. If it succeed, the enemies will target him instead of Kuroko while having the effect of [b]Guard[/b] on Haru.
- You can now [b]zoom out[/b] in the field, and control the camera while selecting a command in battle.
- [b]Fast forward[/b] time anywhere with L3 / F (press) and R3 / T (toggle).
- Switch the display language by pressing SELECT / L.
- Savepoints now have a sound effect when close by - that you can disable in the options.
- Improved [b]stereoscopic 3D[/b] mode: Activate it in the options on the title menu, then go ingame and press F6-F7 to change the [b]convergence[/b] and F8-F9 for the [b]separation[/b].

And many more improvements and fixes!

Most of these changes comes from [b]Episode 2[/b] - now playable on Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

notes.title: Update on Light Fairytale Episode 2 (September 2020)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022398/540fbb12c1d76a8b3f7628cc3932493208896138.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! Here's a quick update about the current status and plans for episode 2 of my JRPG series Light Fairytale.

I've been focusing on the development of episode 2 since December 2019 and I'm happy to announce that it is now playable from start to finish in term of exploration and events! Including 3 towns and 3 dungeons.

I will now work on the battle part. I've done preliminary work on the 5 boss battles but still need to implement their unique skills. I've also implemented many normal battles but still lacking quite a few.

After that, I'll work on implementing a few new features, then start the finalization / polishing / testing process. That's around the time when I'll launch the Early Access on Steam as I will need testers.

The Early Access should still happen this year. Please wishlist episode 2 to be notified on the release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199760

Here's a few work-in-progress screenshots. Again, thanks for your support and patience! This is a very ambitious project for a mostly solo effort, I'll hope you'll understand.

notes.title: Full Release Patch #6: A few fixes!
notes.content:
Full Release version 2020-05-22 changelog:

- Fixed a bug causing the game to get stuck at the elevator event in Kuroko's story. Thanks @Koby!
- Much better performance with the custom setting Ui Quality set to High (instead of Very High / Ultra) or when using the global quality preset High or lower.
The FPS increase should be major on a system with a low performance GPU and a high resolution display.
- Fixed the Anime videos not showing on Linux.

Note: If you have a black screen on Linux please try this command line parameter:
-force-vulkan
To set this parameter, please right click on the game's icon on Steam > Properties > General > Set Launch Options. Thanks @DarkeoX!

notes.title: Full Release Patch #5: 1st Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[b]Full Release version 2020-05-20 changelog:[/b]

[b]Battles[/b]
- Fury is now on the main command menu and can be skipped / activated when needed. Some stats are temporarily +33% when in fury.
- Adding an elemental orb to the armor will reduce the damage received from that element.
- Merging orbs will now also give access to the base orb.
- Added a few more orb combinations using the "Everyone" orb.
- Haru's orb sword will now work without an elemental orb.
- Weapons elemental damage is now merged with the initial damage - no more weird multi damage animation.
- Static stats per character and level - no more randomness in stats when leveling up.
- Added many voices in Japanese that triggers in various situations during battles, for both Haru and Kuroko, with subtitles.
- A few visual improvements: New lightning orbs GFXs, elemental orbs are now visible on the weapons, etc.

[b]Misc:[/b]
- Added the battle zones to the completion %. An easy fix is needed to update your global completion: Please load any of your saves, go to the field menu then return to the title screen.
- Modified a few dialogues such as the first cutscene with Emiko and the ending cutscenes.
- Added subtitles to the OP Anime. If you've completed Haru's story you can watch it again on the title screen > Extras > Anime.
- Updated Unity from 2017 to 2019 which have removed the resolution dialog as it's now deprecated. Though you can launch the game with command line parameters if needed:
[url=https://neko.works/upload/650.png]neko.works/upload/650.png[/url]
- Added a few input alternatives as requested:
NumPad5: A.R. Goggles.
E: Validate.
- Updated both DLCs with a few more art.

And many more minor improvements and fixes!

notes.title: Full Release Patch #3: Improved user interface resolution.
notes.content:
[b]Full Release version 2019-06-16 changelog:[/b]
[list][*]The user interface including all 2D elements such as texts and portraits is now rendered separately in a higher resolution resulting in sharper details.
The 3D elements still depends on the internal resolution. So, you can now mix high resolution 2D with low resolution 3D (good performance while still having readable texts).
[*]New graphics setting: User Interface. Set it to either High (default) or Ultra (for high-end devices).
[*]New graphics setting: Horizontal Resolution - which complement the Internal Resolution setting. Set it to 75% for a decent performance boost while still looking good enough.
[*]And a few more minor fixes.[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch #2: A few fixes, and experimental Mac support!
notes.content:
[b]Early Access version 18-11-28 changelog:[/b]
[list][*]Experimental Mac support. Please give it a try and leave your feedback!
[*]New input system: The game now supports most gamepads out of the box - including the DualShock 4. Unfortunately it is not possible to customize the mappings anymore.
[*]The "Guard" command in battle now activate faster.
[*]Changed the default inputs for the stealth mini-game. You now navigate with "Left" / "Right" rather than "Fire1" / "Fire2".

[*]Added a few background artworks to the Anime DLC.
[*]And a few more minor fixes and improvements.[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch #1: Linux support, and more!
notes.content:
[b]Early Access version 18-11-23 changelog:[/b]
[list][*]Linux support.
[*]The global user save - containing all of your unlocked data and stats - is now also updated when you return to the title screen without saving or on a gameover.
[*]Improved characters collision - should result in less wall stopping and slightly easier [spoiler]finite runner mini-game[/spoiler].
[*]You can now rest at Haru's place any time ([spoiler]even during the spiders battles[/spoiler]).
[*]New option: "Auto Sprint in Field".
[*]New stats: "Total Credits Earned", "Total Credits Spent", "Battles Won" and "Battles Lost".
[*]New leaderboards: "Total Credits Earned" and "Battles Won".
[*]Gamepads' DPad support - for both the menus and controlling your character.
[*]New default keyboard mapping:
[list][*]Arrows / WASD: Menu navigation / Character control.
[*]LCtrl / Enter: Validate / Interact.
[*]LShift / Backspace: Cancel / Sprint.
[*]Q: A.R. goggles.
[*]Space / Tab: Field menu.
[*]Escape: Pause / Skip / Help.
[*]Home-End / PUp-PDown: Camera look around.
[*]Z: Camera zoom-in.[/list]
[*]Fixed the camera on the first battles.
[*]Fixed a bug where Haru gets stuck on the right bridge at the junction, and on the door at the parts shop.
[*]Fixed instabilities when pausing the game - The mysterious girl disappearing during the intro.
[*]Fixed a few typos. Thanks @shayoko !
[*]And a few more minor fixes and improvements.[/list]
